nodes.label: M8.5
nodes.title: Avoid Broad Exception Masking
nodes.question: Review this badly designed exception handling structure. Why is trapping errors using a broad, unqualified except Exception: clause or raw except: considered a dangerous programming practice here?

options.text: It will trigger a critical compile-time SyntaxError due to the typo.
It creates a dangerous logic obfuscation bug by capturing a NameError and silently masking it as an expected data conversion failure.
It forces the program to crash immediately with an unhandled TypeError instead.
It prevents the execution of any subsequent conditional chains or loops downstream.

nodes.explanation: A broad exception handler hides programming mistakes such as misspelled function names, making the program report the wrong failure reason.
